acceptance_criteria.criterion: The one-shot GitHub-native Source Handling bootstrap entrypoint is exercised end to end at the command boundary against a real anchored ledger, covering the first bootstrap, idempotent re-dispatch, tampered and foreign pre-existing ledgers, anchor weakening, trust-root and signing-key mismatches, re-run refusal, lost compare-and-swap, crash before and after a durable write with prefix recovery, single-ref write scope, and secret non-disclosure.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_issue_agent_source_handling_bootstrap_entry.py (22 entrypoint tests driving scripts/hunter_issue_agent_lifecycle.py against a local bare remote and an authenticated GitHub read double).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every refusal the bootstrap can raise is a bounded, documented machine-checked refusal or freeze code rather than an unhandled traceback, and failure leaves no out-of-scope durable write.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_issue_agent_lifecycle.py cmd_source_handling_bootstrap translation layer and the store git normalization; the suite was red on the untouched entrypoint (11 of the first 21 tests) and is green after the fix; no Traceback in stdout or stderr for any refusal path.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: ADR 0038 Implementation Status and the ADR 0037 S6 status text describe the implementation that actually exists after PR #562 and PR #564, without claiming a dispatched bootstrap or a written state ref.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/ADR/0038-source-handling-github-native-authority-store.md and docs/ADR/0037-github-native-issue-agent-execution.md edits in this range; Architecture Index Guard PASS.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The range introduces no second Source Handling authority, ledger, SPM, DPM or publisher, changes no trust root or pinned authorization rule, dispatches no bootstrap, and writes no production state ref.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Changed paths are limited to the lifecycle entrypoint, the ledger store git normalization, its test file and two ADR implementation-status sections; config/issue_agent_trust_roots.json and the workflow are untouched; refs/heads/hunter-state/v1/source-handling remains absent on origin.
